people.name: Ezra
people.line: Priest; scribe; led a group of exiles back to Jerusalem.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: For Ezra had set his heart to seek Yahweh’s law, and to do it, and to teach statutes and ordinances in Israel.
translations.bsb: For Ezra had set his heart to study the Law of the LORD, to practice it, and to teach its statutes and ordinances in Israel.
translations.kjv: For Ezra had prepared his heart to seek the law of the LORD, and to do it, and to teach in Israel statutes and judgments.
translations.asv: For Ezra had set his heart to seek the law of Jehovah, and to do it, and to teach in Israel statutes and ordinances.
